transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess… work mistakes, mostly. I’m a camera operator and editor, and I keep making these stupid technical errors I know better than to make—labeling camera cards wrong, missing timecode notes, exporting cuts with the wrong lower-third even after I checked them. It’s gotten embarrassing, and it scared me enough to come in.
Do you feel anxious or on edge when you're working on these camera operations and edits?
I’m not sure. I mean, I get stressed when I realize I’ve messed something up, but I wouldn’t say I’m sitting there feeling anxious the whole time. It’s more… I don’t know, I notice it after.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?
Not really… I mean, I get frustrated with myself, but I wouldn’t say I’ve been sad or down, no.
Do you find yourself having recurring thoughts that you can't seem to get out of your head?
Not really. I mean, I’ll replay a mistake in my head for a bit, but I don’t think it’s like… thoughts I can’t get rid of.
Do you feel anxious when you're about to start working on a new camera operation or edit?
Not really, no. I might feel a little pressure to get it right, but I wouldn’t call it anxious exactly.
Have you been avoiding certain work tasks or projects because of your concerns about making mistakes?
I don’t think I avoid them, no. I might put something off a bit if I’m not sure about it, but it’s not really because I’m scared of making mistakes.
Do you have any repetitive behaviors that you feel compelled to do?
No, I don’t think so. I mean, nothing I feel like I have to repeat or do a certain way like that.
Do you often find yourself worrying about things in general?
I don’t think so. I mean, I worry about normal stuff sometimes, but not… all the time or anything.
Do you have thoughts that keep coming back to you even when you try to focus on something else?
Not really. I mean, things pop into my head sometimes, but I wouldn’t say they keep coming back in a way I can’t shake.
Do you have thoughts that are intrusive or unwanted?
No, not really. I mean… I get random thoughts like anyone, but nothing that feels intrusive or unwanted in that way.
Have you been feeling more tired than usual lately?
Not especially. I mean, I get tired like anyone, but I haven’t really noticed it being more than usual.
Do you worry about everyday things more than you think you should?
I don’t think so. I worry about normal stuff, I guess, but not more than I should… at least not that I’ve noticed.
Have your mistakes at work caused problems in your relationships with colleagues or affected your overall job performance?

Yeah… a bit. I think some producers trust me less now with the more complicated shoots. And, um, it’s probably hurt my chances of moving up into a senior DP role, even though the actual camera work is good.
Do you find yourself constantly thinking about how to correct your past mistakes or prevent future ones?
I don’t think I’m constantly thinking about it, no. I mean, I try to be more careful afterward, but I don’t sit there obsessing over it or anything.
Have you felt like your mistakes at work have significantly affected your overall well-being or daily life outside of work?
Not really, no. I mean, it’s frustrating and I’ll think about it a little after work, but I don’t think it’s taken over my life or anything.
Do you find it hard to concentrate on your work when you're doing camera operations and edits?

Yeah… sometimes. It’s not like I can’t do the work, but I’ll miss dumb technical stuff I really should catch. Like labeling camera cards wrong, missing a timecode note, or exporting a cut with the wrong lower-third even after I thought I checked it. That’s kind of what scared me into coming in.
Do you worry about everyday things, like work or finances, even when things are going well?
Not really. I mean, I think about bills and work like anyone does, but if things are going okay, I’m not usually sitting there worrying about them.
Do you think you're paying attention when you make these technical errors?

I think I am, that’s the weird part. I’ll feel like I checked it, but then later it’s something obvious—wrong card label, missed timecode note, wrong lower-third on a client cut. Stuff I really should know better than to miss.
Do you often feel like you're worrying about something, even when there's no obvious reason to worry?
No… I don’t think so. I’m not usually worried for no reason. It’s more when there’s actually something going on.
Do you think your mind is elsewhere when you're making these technical errors?

Maybe. I don’t always feel like I’m off somewhere else, though. It’s more like I think I’m checking things, and then I still miss something dumb—like a card label or a timecode note, or I’ll export a client cut and the lower-third is wrong. That’s… kind of what scared me into coming in.
